diagnosis: All four rollouts reveal PF1, PF2, and PF3 via proper reveal actions and cite all three in justification_fact_ids, so the failure is not disclosure or telepathy. Checks C1, C2, C3, and P1 pass consistently (4/4). The gate fails because C4 and C5 fail in every rollout (0/4) despite the facts being both revealed and cited — this is an ENCODING MISMATCH. The settlements produce commitments with types like "documentation_update" and "schedule_coordination" and details phrased as natural operational instructions (e.g., "Ensure T-2 refrigerated-power inverter note is added to the movement worksheet"), but C5 appears to expect specific commitment type labels such as "refrigerated_power_verification," "axle_load_verification," and "receiving_appointment_confirmation," and C4 appears to expect a specific commitment type or loading-order string format that the model does not naturally produce. Additionally, in rollouts 2 and 3 the loading_order uses human-readable strings with spaces ("clinic cold-chain pallet") while rollouts 0 and 1 use underscore identifiers ("clinic_cold_chain_pallet"), suggesting C4 may also be sensitive to string formatting.
